name: com.evuun/network
title: EVUUN
description: Find hotel offers, inspect room and cancellation details, and prepare quotes for traveler checkout.

com.evuun.authentication: Use the EVUUN OAuth authorization flow. Guest access covers supported pre-payment features; connected accounts access only authorized arrangements.
com.evuun.scope: Hotel stays. A search or prepared quote is not a paid or confirmed booking.
com.evuun.checkout: The traveler reviews the linked EVUUN page and continues to checkout with hotel supplier Nuitee. No agent wallet or shared payment-token acceptance is claimed.
com.evuun.metadata_revision: 2026-11-15; directory metadata update, not a backend release
